request.description: A booked slot cannot be changed (409).

item.name: Delete a slot (owner DOCTOR or ADMIN)

request.description: A booked slot cannot be deleted (409).
Atomically claims the slot and creates a `PENDING_PAYMENT` consultation. Exactly one of several concurrent requests for the same slot succeeds; the others get 409.
Patients see their own, doctors see theirs, admins see all.
Decrypted `notes` are included for the treating doctor only.
Allowed from `PENDING_PAYMENT` or `CONFIRMED`.

item.name: Move to another slot of the same doctor (PATIENT, ADMIN)

request.description: CONFIRMED to IN_PROGRESS, from 10 minutes before the scheduled start until its end.
`IN_PROGRESS` to `COMPLETED`.
Stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM).
One active prescription per consultation. Medications and instructions are stored encrypted.

item.name: Get the active prescription of a consultation
Create a payment intent for a pending consultation (PATIENT)

request.description: Returns the existing pending payment if one already exists.

Authenticated by `X-Signature`, the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body using `PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. Idempotent: replays are ignored. `payment.succeeded` moves the payment to `SUCCEEDED` and the consultation to `CONFIRMED` in one transaction; if the consultation is no longer pending, the payment is refunded automatically.

item.name: Get a payment (owner PATIENT or ADMIN)

request.description: Only `SUCCEEDED` payments. The refunded total can never exceed the paid amount, even under concurrent refunds.
